notes.title: Dev diary #1 + #2. Landing in the city, collecting resources
notes.notes:
A year ago we decided to redesign the main parts of our game. The goal is to make the world as fluid as possible, and to have a new unifying main character where the player can choose either first or third person view. Since we've been working on the change for a long time, we decided to release working development footage of the new version of our game to let you know where development is going and what the new version looks like.

The main upcoming changes
- New character, new weapons, new directory, smooth fps and 3ps selection
- redesigned planets with the option to land anywhere without uploading
- unification of missions under one main character


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=l2HByDG6Lgk

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V3jNM8F55_I

notes.title: What we are preparing for you in the next version.
notes.notes:
We are currently working on a larger volume of changes. For now, at least, we'd like to give you an idea of what we're working on.

A new character and work on the surface of planets without loading.

The main change in the pipeline is an attempt to make a persistent universe without recording. For now, we're going to handle this with an intermediate step. 

We've created an exploration droid that you'll be able to drop on the surface of the planet. The droid will have access to weapons and will be able to fly briefly.

We're significantly enlarging the planets and adding detail to them. The result should be the ability to operate on the surface of a planet without recording screens and with complete freedom.

The game should have a smoother and more interesting experience. So far we're working on Mars, then we'll probably try to remake an exoplanet.

All systems will run concurrently for now, i.e. all existing parts of the game can be used.

You won't be able to land the ship yet, but you will be able to jump anywhere above the surface.

New droid features under consideration:
1) taking over factories on the surface without recording
2) taking over combat missions on the surface.

Unfortunately, these big changes require a lot of work and interference with the system, so we can't release it as a demo yet. 


2) we are fixing and finishing the complete colonization module

Once finalised, it will be released as a smaller standalone game

notes.title: Redesigned supercruise, redesigned planets - Demo patch 18
notes.notes:
[b]Redesigned supercruise[/b]
We've spent a long time figuring out how to redesign the supercruise speed to make the game smoother and travel more comfortable.

In the end, we made the following changes:
1) the supercruise ship stops at 0 only when interplanetary knitting. This is to prevent it from crashing into a planet.

2) when the supercruise is switched off, or when the brakes are applied, the ship does not stop again, but slows down to speed 900. The supercruise therefore now acts as a throttle that you can repeatedly add

3) we have significantly improved the brakes to slow it down from zero speed.



[b]Redesigned planets[/b]

We have implemented a new engine for planets that provides more detail. We have reworked most of the planets outside of Earth and the smaller moons.

We have opened up several new options for missions on planets without landing.

notes.title: New car races! Demo patch 16 - fixes, optimizations
notes.notes:
[b]FX1 Grand Prix[/b]
FX1 Grand Prix is the largest automotive organization in the galaxy. We have combined circuit racing, outdoor racing and acrobatic racing under one brand. 

All races are run in unified cars, slightly modified according to the type of track. FX1 has two categories - amateur and elite. You are free to choose!

[b]Important changes and modifications to the game[/b]
- Content optimization - reduction of the demo by 20Gb
- Upload optimization - we've redesigned the upload in some parts of the game, significantly reducing the upload time. We will still work on this part
- reputation change - it's now from -100 to 100. We are opening the way for possible reputation changes during the game
- optimization of production in factories. We have modified the construction camera and now it is possible to draw from the export container directly to the ship's cargo without destroying it

[b]Other fixes[/b]
- We've mainly focused on fixing hundreds of bugs in the game in this patch, we'll continue to do so.

notes.title: Demo patch 13 update - new sport Bloody Games, updates, news
notes.notes:
The new patch brings many fixes and changes. At the same time we add one of the most popular sports in the galaxy - Bloody Games. 


[b]Bloody Games[/b]
Bloody Games are one of the most popular sports in the galaxy. Any visitor can take part in the games. It is easy to get rich and lose your life in the games.

Several disciplines are competed in - all fights are to the death, which is why the games are so popular. The original inspiration was the gladiatorial games in ancient Rome. However, the Blood Games are accessible to anyone and are hugely watched and attended. There are colosseums all over the galaxy, mostly on habitable planets.

[b]The most important changes in the game[/b]
All planets and moons have been redesigned by adding points of interest to them. You can land anywhere as before, but now you can land in certain locations (including cities - see last patch). Resource deposits have been added to the locations. I.e. if you want to build a factory on a new planet, you have to land on a location marked as: Resources.

So a new arena for Bloody Games has been added on habitable planets where you can land. We've also added the InSight lander landing on Mars and separated out the entire Apollo 11 on the moon.

In the future we plan to add many points of interest, games, etc... to the planets in addition to cities.

notes.title: Cities! - New demo megapatch - update 12

We are adding all cities to the game! Now each explorer can choose to land only at the airport as before or land inside the city. We'll be adding lots of content and new missions to the cities as we go!

If you fly to any city, you can choose to land at the main air terminal as before, where you can do the same actions as now (trade, missions, etc...). Or you can land directly in the city using the capsule.


Along with all cities, we are adding the first two professions in the city to the game:

1) Taxi Driver - you can now drive around the city and deliver customers.
2) Air Taxi Driver - similar profession, but this time with an air taxi!

At the same time, small shops with directory material have been moved to the cities.

What we are planning in the cities:
- other new professions - moving materials, police etc...
- complete building of factories for new goods
- construction of our own commercial buildings.

notes.title: Demo patch 8 released - new planetary system, new missions
notes.notes:
The Alpha Centauri planetary system will be added in the new patch. The system contains two new planets that have been discovered by current scientists. We're also adding wreck search missions, movie cameras, and lots of other improvements.

[b]Alpha Centauri[/b]
You can now fly from the solar system directly to Alpha Centauri. You'll also find now-familiar planets discovered by our current generation in the system. Go to paradise on earth or to an inhospitable planet. You may even meet the first pirate station.

[b]New missions[/b]
You can now encounter wreck exploration missions at planets and collect materials from them.

[b]New drone features[/b]
You can now use the drone to collect items in space.

[b]New cameras[/b]
You can now use F1,F2,F3 to switch to movie cameras for a better flight experience

We have also added many gameplay fixes and minor adjustments

notes.title: New big update of the demo - asteroid building - Patch 7
notes.notes:
Today we've updated the demo with the latest version of the game, which has a lot of new features.


[b]Building on asteroids[/b]
There are now building asteroids near the planets in every system. You can build factories and manufacture on them. This new part is just the basis, in the future we plan to build cities and stations on them as well.

Now you can send a construction drone at any time and start building on these asteroids.

Asteroids can be found at Jupiter, Saturn, Eden and Hope.


[b]New ship - Explorer[/b]
Each player can now choose at the beginning of the game whether to start with the existing transporter or choose the faster and better equipped explorer. This ship can also be used to land on planets.



[b]Other changes and modifications[/b]
We have redesigned the entire planet earth and moon. Earth is now much bigger, and we plan to have a lot of fun on it in the future.

Redesigned Mars to HD textures, Jupiter and other planets.

With the new ship and launch, redesigned the save system - need to start a new game.

notes.title: Colonization module. New big update released - patch 6
notes.notes:
A new planet colonization module has been added to the game. Build a thriving colony on many planets! In addition, all planet surfaces have been redesigned and graphics have been improved.

[b]Colonization module[/b]
You can now colonise selected planets. When you arrive at a planet, you are offered the opportunity to build a colony on the planet. You can transfer the money you earn from the colony immediately to your ship.

We will continue to improve and refine the module as the game develops.

At the moment it is possible to colonize:
Mars
Moon
Mercury
Io
Europa
Titan
Pluto
Eden
Venus

notes.title: Patch 5 released - new ships with landing module
notes.notes:
The new version brings a number of new features. Brand new 2 ships with landing module, redesigned planets, optimizations, bug fixes.

[b]2 new spacecraft[/b]

[b]Lander FK2 Delta[/b]
The Delta is slightly larger than the Lander FK1 Transporter. It carries a vehicle instead of a hover. It has a little better cargo space and other parameters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778391/2ffb4f6ab9353acae5f54e4bccc7c6cb4e4be7de.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43778391/036dcd14baf183b958924ad3f7f4b453fd1c4a55.jpg[/img]


[b]Lander FK10 Infinity[/b]

The FK10 Infinity Lander, on the other hand, is the largest final ship in the game that can land on planets.

It has a very good cargo hold. You can also use a small transport fighter, a robot and a vehicle on the planet.

Infinity has a large cargo and very good other parameters. It's so big that you can move around inside it using hover. Since you can't easily land on all planets due to the size, you can also use a fast capsule landing.

notes.title: Patch 4 released - local multiplayer added
notes.notes:
We've added local multiplayer and a few new features. You can now play several missions with a friend. There will be a combat drone and a fighter jet, or a large battleship.

[b]Local multiplayer[/b]
- possibility to play as a combination of :combat drone + fighter, or drone + battleship

- several missions - training, offensive and defensive

[b]Other modifications and new features[/b]
- First person camera added for explorer
- improved visuals for all cities and the surface of inhabited planets

- added option to turn mouse inversion on/off
- Dozens of minor improvements and modifications
- bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch 3 is out! Factories and production!
notes.notes:
FACTORY
There are now large deposits of raw materials on every planet and moon. You can now freely build factories ranging from single factories to mega-complexes. Goods can then be distributed to orbit and traded with all cities and space stations.

Factories can be invented and stacked at your discretion. Virtually any commodity can be produced, or you can focus on producing only simple raw materials.

OTHER NEWS
- rebalanced ship attributes
- if you have a lander, you will now land directly on the planet (instead of stopping in the air)
- new types of goods that can be traded
- new instructions on the planet

The patch contains many other adjustments and fixes...

We're not slacking off and are preparing more massive news for you! We will be gradually introducing them into our game. 

Try out the factories in DEMU and let us know your thoughts and any bugs you find. 

Thank you!

notes.title: Patch 2 released
notes.notes:
Today, the free demo version of our game has been updated with a number of fixes and adjustments.


[b]Modified flight mode and supercruise[/b]
- Newly can achieve 8x faster speed without supercruise
- In connection with this new feature, a new "X" key for quick braking has been added. We have also added this feature to the gamepad
- Supercruise loads faster

[b]Improved ship AI[/b]
- We have adjusted the AI of ships. You will now find more of them around stations and stargates
- We've adjusted the command options for custom ships

[b]Modified the strategic map[/b]
- We've modified the strategic map to make it easier to control your own ships.

[b]Modified the carg trading system[/b]
- Redesigned the goods system. Now each station offers its own type of goods (before everyone offered everything)

[b]Other modifications[/b]
- ships are automatically undocked when purchased
- Dozens of other minor fixes and adjustments

notes.title: Free demo release!
notes.notes:
Dear fans of Space Travellers, we would like to inform you about the release of a free demo of our game. The demo contains the entire Solar System and one adjacent system with an alien world.

Play, enjoy and write us in the discussions how you like the demo :-)
